Micro Application Generator (rtiddsmag)
=======================================

Apache Commons CLI
------------------
-  Used in Micro Application Generator.
-  Version 1.4
-  Open Source Software License: Apache License Version 2.0 (full text found in
   :ref:`section-3rdparty-licenses`).

Apache Commons Lang 3
---------------------
-  Used in Micro Application Generator. We only use the class StringUtils.
-  Version 3.7
-  Open Source Software License: Apache License Version 2.0 (full text found in
   :ref:`section-3rdparty-licenses`).

Apache Log4j 2
--------------
-  This software is distributed with rtiddsmag (Micro Application Generator) as
   a jar file. The source code is not modified or shipped.
-  Source: https://logging.apache.org/
-  Version: 2.25.3
-  Open Source Software License: Apache License Version 2.0 (full text found in
   :ref:`section-3rdparty-licenses`).

Apache Velocity

-  Source: http://velocity.apache.org/
-  Version: 2.0
-  Open Source Software License: Apache License Version 2.0 (full text found in
   :ref:`section-3rdparty-licenses`).
